title: [Bookworm] [techsupport] test_techsupport_commands failed due to no "/proc/sched_debug" in the cp commands
author: vivekkarri
body:

#### Description

/proc/sched_debug is missing in bookworm

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run the  `show_techsupport/test_techsupport.py::test_techsupport_commands` test 
2. Or run techsupport and check the `/proc/sched_debug` file


#### Describe the results you received:
```
cat dump.proc/sched_debug
/proc/sched_debug not found
```

comments.author: gechiang
comments.body: fix is in sonic-utilities that @vivekrnv is aware of and will retest to confirm before closing.

comments.author: saiarcot895
comments.body: `/proc/sched_debug` collection removed in sonic-net/sonic-utilities@fe11c2ea8801995ea4cdd15837df83ec365679cc. sonic-net/sonic-mgmt#10718 will remove the test code that checks for this.

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?

In the Bookworm kernel, /proc/sched_debug has been moved to debugfs. For now, don't collect this file. If this file is needed, and debugfs collection code gets added to techsupport, then this can be updated.

#### How did you do it?

If the device is running on a kernel older than 5.13.0, then look for `/proc/sched_debug` to be present; otherwise, don't look for it.

#### How did you verify/test it?

Tested on a Bookworm KVM device.
